tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in agent account: kind, masked email, preferences (digest hour and format, Breaking News rule), topics followed and Breaking News emails sent in the last 24 hours. Use it to check what the account will receive before changing anything. Needs a token.

tools.name: update_preferences
tools.description: Change what the account receives: digest on or off, hour (7, 12, 18 or 21 local), time zone and format (text, json or html); Breaking News on or off, threshold 0.0 to 1.0, composite (min, mean, geo or breaking) and a cap of 1 to 20 emails a day; reminder emails. tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the topics this account follows (with tier: instant emails or the daily roundup) and suggested topics with their keys and recent story counts. Use it before follow_topic to pick a key, or to find a topic_id for unfollow_topic. Needs a token.

tools.name: follow_topic
tools.description: Follow a topic by free text (a place, person, organisation or issue, resolved the way the site's Track box does), by a suggestion key (t88, g1045) or by topic_id. tier "instant" sends an email when a matching brief is published (up to 3 a day); "daily" (default) adds one roundup at the digest hour.

tools.name: unfollow_topic
tools.description: Stop following one topic by topic_id (from list_topics). Its alerts stop; other topics, the digest and Breaking News are unchanged. Unfollowing a topic not followed changes nothing. Needs a token.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Get the daily Indian Opinion digest as structured data: the same stories, in the same order, as the email of that day, each with category, outlet count, framing split, a summary and url, md_url and json_url. tools.description: List the stories scored for Breaking News in the last 1 to 7 days, each with its four Jev scores (breaking, new_event, high_stakes, confirmed), the four composites, whether this account's current rule would send it, and what was actually delivered. tools.name: get_breaking_event
tools.description: Get one Breaking News event by event_id (from list_breaking or the json_url in a Breaking News email): headline, scores, composites, whether your rule sends it, delivery status, the brief and its sources. Needs a token.

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Stop emails to this account: "digest" (the daily digest), "breaking" (Breaking News), "topics" (every followed topic) or "all" (all of those and reminders). tools.name: create_browser_link
tools.description: Create a one-time link (valid 10 minutes, single use) that signs a browser in to this account and opens /account/, so the human behind the agent can see or change settings on the site. Give the link only to that person. Needs a token.

tools.name: close_account
tools.description: Close the signed-in account: every token is revoked (this one too, so later calls fail), the digest, Breaking News, topic alerts and reminders stop, and the address can no longer sign in. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "signup_verify" references sensitive artifacts (secret, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brief, signup_start, get_account, list_topics, get_digest, get_breaking_event · Private data: signup_verify, get_account, update_preferences, list_topics, follow_topic, unfollow_topic, get_digest, list_breaking, get_breaking_event, unsubscribe, create_browser_link, close_account · Public sink: get_brief, signup_start, get_account, update_preferences, follow_topic, get_digest, list_breaking, get_breaking_event, close_account · Destructive: get_account, update_preferences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brief, signup_start, get_account, list_topics, get_digest, get_breaking_event · Private data: signup_verify, get_account, update_preferences, list_topics, follow_topic, unfollow_topic, get_digest, list_breaking, get_breaking_event, unsubscribe, create_browser_link, close_account · Public sink: get_brief, signup_start, get_account, update_preferences, follow_topic, get_digest, list_breaking, get_breaking_event, close_account · Destructive: get_account, update_preferences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
